items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Luke was the first trumpet player with the show... Fleming knowing that I was in Paris, he contacted me... he'd have to find someone... asked Luke... Luke, yes. Luke, yes.

ctx.x:

that I was in Paris, and he had Luke Smith,
